summary.headline: Hyleg and Length of Life
summary.text: Astrological rules for judging fragile life, death timing, and the quality of nourishment through profections, malefic aspects, the fifth sign, the Moon, and the seventh place. Chapter II introduces the Hyleg and life-span calculation, beginning with criteria for selecting the Hyleg in diurnal nativities from the Sun, house, term, exaltation, triplicity, and face lords.
